input: Batch cook and freeze three soups this weekend

gold.taskTitle: Batch cook and freeze three soups this weekend
gold.taskDescription: Plan and execute a weekend batch cooking session to prepare three soups and store them in the freezer.

questions.title: Which three specific soups do you want to make?
questions.description: Identify the exact soup recipes the user plans to cook.

questions.title: How many servings of each soup do you need?
questions.description: Determine the total volume to cook per soup so quantities and equipment can be planned.

questions.title: Do you already have the recipes chosen and saved?
questions.description: Find out whether recipe research and selection is still needed or already done.

questions.title: What freezer containers or bags do you currently have?
questions.description: Understand what storage supplies are on hand versus what needs to be purchased.

questions.title: Which day this weekend are you cooking, Saturday or Sunday?
questions.description: Pin down the specific cooking day to structure a timeline around it.

questions.title: Do you need to shop for ingredients before cooking?
questions.description: Determine whether a grocery run is part of the plan or ingredients are already stocked.

questions.title: Are there any dietary restrictions these soups must meet?
questions.description: Capture any dietary constraints such as gluten-free, dairy-free, or low-sodium that affect recipe choices.
